svg.title: What I'm building — Klinova, SignProof, PartTrace, PolicyPulse
svg.desc: Four product cards: Klinova (pharmacy and healthcare, fax intake list), SignProof (Canadian e-signature, a signature being drawn and sealed), PartTrace (RFID parts tracking radar), PolicyPulse (policy signals, impact score and confidence sparkline).
svg.text: Each product carries only what makes it different — auth, signing, storage and payments are shared services.
